title: 005误会
slug: 年少情深被辜负他跪了我不要了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

十几秒后，李铭烨才压低声音，边推开门边说：

“没事，手滑不小心摔坏了你嫂子的护肤品。”

周冉冉极快地扫过溅了一地的乳液和玻璃碎渣，迅速收回目光，轻轻挽住李铭烨的胳膊。

“刚好我们今天给嫂子买的礼物是护肤品，真是新的不去旧地不来，哥哥你去客厅休息下，我来打扫这里。”

倏然，李铭烨牵着周冉冉的手腕走到了客厅，“让王姨去打扫就好，你陪我坐会。”

下一秒，王姨便熟练地拿着扫帚和抹布，进了洗手间。

关门之后，王姨给林萧发了微信。

【夫人，李总他带周冉冉回家了，你现在回来吗？】

发完，王姨便删除了信息记录，小心翼翼地装好手机。

两年前她儿子在工地干活出了事，老板死不认账，是林萧帮忙请的律师，打赢了官司。

自那之后，王姨便一心一意的跟着林萧。

还没等林萧回复，王姨就通过半掩的门缝儿，听到了客厅内的对话。

“冉冉，你觉得你嫂子这人怎么样？”李铭烨全程挤着牙齿，拳头死死攥着，手臂上的青筋若隐若现。

周冉冉眼珠子一转，食指抵在下唇，“我觉得嫂子是个很好的人，长得漂亮，身材好，人又聪明，听说她以前还是学霸呢。”

“不过...”周冉冉收回手，坐得端端正正，突然话锋一转，“不过像嫂子这样的人，很容易被人惦记呢，哥哥你可得看住了，千万不能让嫂子出去工作，要不然...哥哥你懂的。”

周冉冉的话说到了李铭烨的心坎里，他虽然气得要死，但在对方面前，还是保持了明面上的冷静。

“我知道了，冉冉，谢谢你的提醒。”

倏然，周冉冉没再说什么，她只是睨着眼，将李铭烨从头到脚扫视了一遍，随后站起来朝门走了两步，又侧过半个身子，挥手说：

“好了，哥哥，今晚我要去图书馆复习，你呀，就和嫂子度过一个美好的夜晚吧~不用送我，我自己打车过去！”

见状，李铭烨摇头叹息，随后冷冷说：“好好考试，考得好有奖励。”

“什么奖励都可以吗？”

“这...”

没等李铭烨回答，周冉冉便已经笑着走到了门口，她回看一眼，“你给我的‘奖励’已经够多了，那晚的烟花秀真的好美，哥哥，谢谢你。”

听着防盗门重重关上的声音，李铭烨心中泛起一股暖意，他想，要不是周冉冉的温柔安抚了他，估计他今天下午就要把这个家砸得稀巴烂。

为什么结婚三年，林萧变得越来越不懂事？

After more than ten seconds, Li Mingye lowered his voice and said while pushing the door open:

"It's okay. My hands slipped and I accidentally broke your sister-in-law's skin care products."

Zhou Ranran quickly swept away the lotion and glass shards splashed on the floor, quickly looked away, and gently held Li Mingye's arm.

"It just so happens that the gift we bought for my sister-in-law today is skin care products. It's so new that it won't come back to the old place until it's new. Brother, go to the living room and rest. I'll clean this place."

Suddenly, Li Mingye took Zhou Ranran's wrist and walked to the living room, "Just let Aunt Wang clean it. You can sit with me for a while."

The next second, Aunt Wang skillfully took the broom and rag and entered the bathroom.

After closing the door, Aunt Wang sent Lin Xiao a WeChat message.

[Madam, Mr. Li took Zhou Ranran home. Are you coming back now?】

After sending it, Aunt Wang deleted the message record and carefully installed the phone.

Two years ago, her son had an accident while working on a construction site. The boss refused to admit his fault. It was Lin Xiao who helped hire a lawyer and won the lawsuit.

Since then, Aunt Wang has followed Lin Xiao wholeheartedly.

Before Lin Xiao could reply, Aunt Wang heard the conversation in the living room through the half-open door.

"Ran Ran, what do you think of your sister-in-law?" Li Mingye gritted his teeth the whole time, clenched his fists tightly, and the veins on his arms were looming.

Zhou Ranran rolled her eyes and put her index finger on her lower lip, "I think my sister-in-law is a very good person. She is beautiful, has a good figure, and is smart. I heard that she was a top student in the past."

"But..." Zhou Ranran took back her hand, sat upright, and suddenly changed the topic, "But people like my sister-in-law are easily missed by others. Brother, you have to watch out. You must not let your sister-in-law go out to work, otherwise... Brother, you know."

Zhou Ranran's words touched Li Mingye's heart. Although he was furious, he still maintained his apparent calmness in front of the other party.

"I understand, Ranran, thank you for the reminder."

Suddenly, Zhou Ranran didn't say anything else. She just glanced at Li Mingye from head to toe. Then she stood up and took two steps towards the door. She turned half sideways and waved her hand and said:

"Okay, brother, I'm going to the library to review tonight. You and your sister-in-law, just spend a wonderful night~ No need to send me off, I'll take a taxi there myself!"

Seeing this, Li Mingye shook his head and sighed, and then said coldly: "Take the exam well. If you do well, you will be rewarded."

"Can I give you any reward?"

"This..."

Before Li Mingye could answer, Zhou Ranran had already walked to the door with a smile. She looked back and said, "The 'rewards' you gave me are enough. The fireworks show that night was really beautiful. Brother, thank you."

Hearing the sound of the security door slamming shut, Li Mingye felt a warm feeling in his heart. He thought that if Zhou Ranran's gentleness hadn't comforted him, he would have smashed this home to pieces this afternoon.

Why has Lin Xiao become more and more ignorant after three years of marriage?
